items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Yeah, he wanted to ask you some questions. Yeah, I wanted to hear about that Three Al's trio. It was you and Albert Boybanks and Albert John, right? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah.
